svg.title: If Bw has rate b, this has rate b + (t −s)Gv, matching (CE14). On the subtraction halo, choose a point of the original stage differing from the present point only in Ni. Such a point exists by the definition of the halo; for the remaining branch it is the point itself. Constancy of the original continuation in Ni permits evaluating there. Other current parts are orthogonal to Ni, so their palettes and expressions are unaffected. Substituting the child product with its fixed component treatment into the old tagged product is exactly the refined reading. The original path inequality now yields b + (t −s)Gv + X refined parts cj,
